findings.summary: Part-author label fallback rules are still duplicated in the editor reader page.
findings.consequence: Future changes to generated part-author display semantics can drift between the public reader and editor reader because both encode the same surname/full_name/author_id precedence independently.
findings.evidence: The owned helper encodes the fallback order on lines 30-32. The same single-author vs multi-author fallback is independently implemented in app/pages/editor/[lbid]/ix/[ix]/[mediatype].vue lines 132-139 instead of calling this shared helper.
findings.recommendation: Use this shared helper from the editor page as well, or rename it to a neutral work-manifest helper if both reader surfaces own the same display policy.
